thread.title: Qorvo, Skyworks: Macquarie Says Don't Fret Lower iPhone Estimates

author: Tiernan Ray
title: Qorvo, Skyworks: Macquarie Says Don't Fret Lower iPhone Estimates
text: Qorvo, Skyworks: Macquarie Says Don’t Fret Lower iPhone Estimates By Tiernan Ray Jan 23, 2018, 6:11 pm 17 pts Chip makers are in the grip at the moment of declining estimates for Apple’s (AAPL) iPhone, but Macquarie Research’s Srini Pajjuri urges investors in Qorvo (QRVO) and Skyworks Solutions (SWKS) and Broadcom (AVGO) to keep the faith. Writing that 2018 is going to be a “transition year”…
